propositions: Operator needs a reproducible, layered storage footprint report that separately measures packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, git-directory bytes, and whole-clone bytes without conflating pack size with checkout residence or filesystem slack

The tracker-footprint command must be explicitly opt-in, read-only, and never triggered implicitly from ticket writes, reconciliation, gates, metrics, or CI, with size alone never affecting exit status or blocking unrelated work

Fresh-clone mode must resolve a configured tickets remote and branch, create a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone with no hardlink optimization, measure it, and remove only command-owned temporary state, while mounted mode labels a shared object database correctly

The report must identify the measured ref and resolved tip, preserve source refs and remote state unchanged, and handle platform edge cases where st_blocks is unavailable by reporting structured allocation-unavailable values rather than fabricated zeros
Checkout allocation and slack are computed using filesystem block counts when available, while linked-worktree measurement must distinguish shared object stores from standalone clone costs
JSON output validates against tracker_footprint.schema.json, text and JSON rendering include measurement definitions and resolved tip, and no threshold verdict or size-based failure is emitted
